purpose: Replication record: the HBM qualification ladder applied to two vendors without modifying the method. Stances are recomputable from gate answers by the deterministic rule: count consecutive yes answers from G0; the stance is the stance_if_passed of the last consecutively passed gate, or MONITOR if none.

dated sample-shipment disclosure at announcement scope
no customer-named evaluation evidence in the reviewed corpus
no named-customer qualification disclosure in the reviewed corpus
no independently attributable qualification evidence in the reviewed corpus
no dated HBM4E production or volume-shipment evidence in the reviewed corpus

transfer_rule_applications: Bloomberg-carried HBM4 certification remarks (SRC-BBG-20260605) were not transferred to HBM4E qualification.
